create_ParityCheck: create a ParityCheck task instance to generate binary string parity labels with JAX
test_ParityCheck_sample_batch: test the ParityCheck sample_batch method to generate jittable batches of binary strings and parity labels
run_ParityCheck_input_size: run the ParityCheck input_size property to get the one-hot encoded input dimension of 2
run_ParityCheck_output_size: run the ParityCheck output_size property to get the one-hot encoded output dimension of 2
summarize_ParityCheck: summarize the ParityCheck class that computes whether the count of 1s in a binary string is even or odd
